title: OptuML: Hyperparameter Optimization for Multiple Machine Learning Algorithms using Optuna
description: OptuML (for Optuna and ML) is a Python module that provides hyperparameter optimization for several machine learning algorithms using the Optuna framework. The module supports a variety of algorithms and allows easy hyperparameter tuning through a scikit-learn-like API.
notes: This research was funded in part by the National Science Centre in Poland (grant number 2020/39/B/NZ2/03127 to F.S.)
